pages.title: Ask the block
text: Crouch and right-click any Tribal block with the Spirit Codex and it explains itself in plain words.
- Stored Pulse, every generator within **8 blocks** with its output this second, the voices present, the Pulse it could draw, and whether redstone is pausing it.
- Workshops name their recipe, and any missing voice or full output.
- Relays report unloaded or locked endpoints.
- Braziers list the rites their seal allows.
- Pattern anchors show ghosts of missing pieces and name the first three.

pages.title: Make it a habit
text: Whenever something sits still, ask it before you start taking the build apart. Nine times in ten the answer is one line: a quiet voice, a full output, a held signal, or a missing mark.
